title: MCA Amends Schedule VII Companies Act: ZCZP Instruments Eligible Under CSR (Up to 10%)
summary: Allows corporates to allocate up to 10% annual CSR expenditure to Social Stock Exchange instruments.

blocks.content: Allows corporates to allocate up to 10% annual CSR expenditure to Social Stock Exchange instruments.

items: ZCZP Inclusion: Subscription to Zero Coupon Zero Principal (ZCZP) instruments on Social Stock Exchanges added to Schedule VII.
CSR Cap: Companies permitted to allocate up to 10% of annual mandatory CSR outlay to ZCZP instruments.
Zero Returns: ZCZP instruments offer no financial returns or principal repayment; used exclusively for social impact projects.

blocks.content: ZCZP CSR cap (10% of annual CSR expenditure) vs return structure (Zero Coupon Zero Principal).
